title: iCARE participant knowledge record
description: Participant enrolment with optional grouped clinical, cancer-history, risk, care, exercise and other ontology records. Omitted information is not inferred.

schema_version.description: Input profile version; 1.1 adds grouped ontology records.

recorded_at.description: When the participant information was recorded; include Z or an explicit offset.

source.description: Description of the source of these statements, e.g. participant-confirmed enrolment interview.

participant_id.description: Pseudonymous participant identifier, unique across this deployment. Reuse it to reference the same person.

study_id.description: Existing study identifier in the registered pilot setup.

site_id.description: Existing site identifier. Site details are referenced, not copied.

id.description: Enrolment record identifier, unique within the participant's seed.

enrolled_at.description: Start of enrolment; include Z or an explicit UTC offset.

status.description: Explicit participation status; no status is inferred from consent.

phase_id.description: Optional phase declared in the site's study setup.

arm_id.description: Optional assigned study arm declared in the setup.

age_years.description: Optional age snapshot at recorded_at, not an automatically advancing age or eligibility decision.

survivor_role.description: Optional explicitly confirmed survivor role. It is never inferred from current age.

language_tag.description: Participant's supplied language preference, e.g. es-ES. Syntax subset only; no language-registry verification.

contact_time.description: Preferred time of day; does not create a scheduled contact.

attributes.description: Optional textual person attributes; these do not create specialised clinical records or coded diagnoses.

id.description: Stable attribute record identifier within this participant.

consent.description: Optional consent metadata. This profile records status and dates, not consent-purpose enforcement or a complete consent instrument.

status.description: Supplied consent status, never defaulted to granted.

valid_from.description: Start of the supplied consent record's applicability.

valid_until.description: Optional end of applicability; must be later than valid_from.
